title: Coming together to give back this Thanksgiving in Atlanta
body_markdown:
Thanksgiving is a time for coming together, and Norfolk Southern is helping bring that spirit of generosity to families across Atlanta.


Norfolk Southern joined Atlanta artist and philanthropist T.I. and his foundation, Harris Community Works, to support their annual Thanksgiving food and turkey giveaway, helping provide holiday meals to local families and seniors.


**Top Takeaway**


- Norfolk Southern supported T.I. and Harris Community Works' annual Thanksgiving giveaway in Atlanta, helping distribute turkeys and holiday food to community members ahead of Thanksgiving.


**A Thanksgiving tradition of giving back**


For more than 20 years, T.I. and Harris Community Works have brought the Atlanta community together through an annual Thanksgiving food distribution, helping families and seniors put holiday meals on the table.


This year's event, held on Nov. 24 at Jackson Memorial Baptist Church, continued that tradition, with NS once again supporting the effort to distribute turkeys to local residents.


**What we’re saying**


“Thanksgiving is about community, connection, and looking out for one another,” said **Kristin Wong, Director Norfolk Southern Foundation & Community Impact** . “We're proud to continue supporting this longstanding Atlanta tradition. Being able to show up for our neighbors year after year reflects the importance we place on building strong community relationships and helping families celebrate the holidays.”


**Showing up for our Atlanta neighbors**


Giving back to the communities we serve is an important part of who we are. By continuing to support local traditions like this Thanksgiving giveaway, we're helping strengthen community connections and make a meaningful difference for our Atlanta neighbors.


Learn more about our[community impact](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact) efforts.
